headline: Super vs ChatGPT — personal AI agents compared for real computer work

site_brief.goal: Create a fair but persuasive competitor comparison page for Super vs ChatGPT. Use supplied sources for current facts, avoid fake claims, and make the practical argument that Super is better suited for repeated computer-use work because its cache can lower repeated execution cost.
site_brief.title: Super vs ChatGPT

summary: A fair, source‑backed comparison of Super vs ChatGPT for people evaluating personal AI agents and computer‑use automation. ChatGPT remains a world‑class conversational assistant and is expanding into agents and scheduled automation. Super is positioned for users who want durable computer‑use workflows, with a reusable computer‑use cache that makes repeated runs faster and cheaper over time. The page also situates Gemini, Grok, Siri, Folk, and Orchids as market context.
